hero.title: Flexible Physician Contracts, Anywhere in Canada
hero.subtitle: Work short-term, long-term, or permanent physician contracts in hospitals, clinics, and rural health centres nationwide.

blocks.text: Physician Jobs Available Nationwide (Except QC, YT, NWT)
Benefits of Working With Goodwill Staffing

blocks.html: Competitive daily and hourly rates. Paid travel and housing for rural/remote placements. Flexible contract lengths (days to months). National and interprovincial opportunities. Telehealth setup support for virtual placements. Bilingual physician demand in Ontario, NB, NS.

items.question: Do you help with licensing and registration?
items.answer: Yes. We assist with College registration and CPSO, CPSA, CPSBC, etc.

items.question: Are placements fully insured?
items.answer: We confirm malpractice coverage for each assignment and can advise on CMPA.

items.question: Do you work with both new and experienced physicians?
items.answer: We work with recently licensed MDs, Canadian physicians returning from international practice, and seasoned physicians.

items.question: Do you offer remote and rural locums?
items.answer: Many roles are fly-in/fly-out or come with travel and housing.

items.question: Do you place international medical graduates (IMGs)?
items.answer: In some provinces, yes. If you are licensed to practice in Canada, we can help.

blocks.html: Goodwill Staffing places Canadian-licensed physicians in locum and full-time positions across the country. Whether you’re looking for a hospital contract or a rural family practice, we provide housing and rapid onboarding.

blocks.text: Apply Now to Find a Travel Nursing Role That Fits

blocks.html: Let’s turn your skills into impact. Whether you're ready for your first contract or your fifteenth, we're here to support your journey. We respond to all qualified applicants within 1 business day.
